name: singlet_grn_tf_target_edge_inference
title: Directed TF-to-target edge scores
description: Scores every candidate TF against every target gene from an unperturbed log-normalised matrix and writes a ranked directed edge list with no threshold. The default method is grnboost2 with arboreto settings; ppcor with conditioning tfs gives per-edge calibrated statistics. Scores are dependence, not causal effects, so use perturbation tasks for causal claims.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

method.description: Edge scoring method. grnboost2 is the default; ppcor with conditioning tfs gives per-edge Student-t statistics whose calibration is unvalidated (section 10 of the task document).

layer.description: Log-normalised expression layer used for inference.

tf_list.description: Candidate regulators. Defaults to genes flagged in var/is_tf; restricts edge direction by construction.

grnboost2.description: Options for method grnboost2; defaults are the arboreto stochastic gradient boosting settings.

max_estimators.description: Cap on boosting stages; early stopping usually ends earlier.

max_features.description: Fraction of candidate TFs considered at each split.

subsample.description: Row subsampling per stage; must be below 1 for early stopping and scaling.

genie3.description: Options for method genie3, a random forest per target.

n_estimators.description: Number of random-forest trees per target.

max_features.description: Candidate TFs per split: sqrt or a fraction.

ppcor.description: Options for method ppcor, a Gaussian partial correlation per pair.

conditioning.description: all_genes conditions on every other gene; tfs conditions only on other candidate TFs (proposed).

p_value_cutoff.description: If set, pairs above this p-value get weight 0 (BEELINE-compatible output).

pearson.description: Options for method pearson, a marginal correlation per pair.

normalise_per_gene_max.description: Divide each gene by its maximum first (BEELINE behaviour; leaves r unchanged).

seed.description: Random seed for tree methods; pass explicitly for reproducibility.

device.description: auto uses CUDA for pearson and ppcor when memory suffices; tree methods run on CPU.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote edges; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/grn/grnboost2/edges. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: method, conditioning, n_targets, n_tfs, n_edges, failed_targets, seed, device, seconds. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device, planned_targets.
